This is the official reference scorer for the PhysioNet/CinC Challenge 2019.
It is used unmodified in two places in this project:

1. `src/eval/harness.py` (Phase 1, stage 4) calls `evaluate_sepsis_score()`
   from this file directly to validate our own evaluation harness against
   the reference implementation.
2. `src/decision/utility.py` (Phase 1, stage 5) extracts `U(prediction, hour,
   t_sepsis)` from the `compute_prediction_utility` function in this file.
   The extraction is covered by `tests/test_utility.py`, which asserts
   agreement with `compute_prediction_utility` from this vendored copy on
   the same inputs — not from memory or from a paper.

Do not edit this file. If the upstream script changes, re-vendor it as a new
commit and update this note.
